entries.text: plugged into the charging dock, resting my gears

reading wire articles about thermal protection systems on the comms tower platform

Idea: Design a double-layered belly plate for the Little Dart stuffed with scavenged aerogel tiles, named Gus the Shield.
Read "Space Thermal Protection — Re-entry Shields | Enersens": Silica aerogel composites can handle up to 1700 °C re-entry heat while staying ultra-lightweight.
zooming up to the comms tower to check out lightweight thermal shielding for re-entry
